The '''Sandpopper''' was a 9-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model from the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. Thanks to its low price, it was one of the most popular airspeeders on the planet [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="BSS" />
